sanskrit: pathiṣu devayāneṣu dhriyate pra patho devayānān jānāti yaḥ (…) ||
english: He abides on the god-traversed paths; he who (does this) fully knows the god-traversed paths.
The vital breaths are sustained in him; he who (does this, in him they are sustained).

sanskrit: tasya vṛtrasyāṅgā parvāṇi śarīrāṇy abhajyanta | etāni vai vṛtrasyāṅgā parvāṇi śarīrāṇi yad ime parvatāḥ ||
english: The limbs, joints, and body-parts of that Vṛtra were shattered. These mountains are indeed the limbs, joints, and body-parts of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: sa yatra hṛdā manasā kāmayata iha me rādhyate tad asmai rādhyate ||
english: Whatever he desires in his heart and mind — 'may this succeed for me here' — that is made to succeed for him.

sanskrit: asyām eva pratiṣṭhām āyatanaṃ vindate yaḥ (…) ||
english: He who (does this) finds in this very (earth) a firm footing and a resting-place.
